ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Footscray**, there are several well-reviewed locksmiths that install digital and keyless locks.

Here are a few nearby options:

- Lock, Smith and Barrel (West Footscray) – 24/7 emergency locksmith with strong local reputation. Melbourne community recommendations frequently mention them for fair pricing and quality work. [www.reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/melbourne/comments/1jy8cqa?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Onpoint Locksmith (Footscray) – Local locksmith offering keyless lock services with excellent customer ratings.
- Innerwest Locksmiths (Footscray) – Local mobile locksmith servicing the inner west.
- Precision Locksmiths Melbourne (Spotswood) – Nearby 24/7 locksmith experienced with residential security.
- Omega Security Solutions (Yarraville) – Supplies and installs a range of electronic locking systems.

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- Straightforward smart lock replacement: **A$150–A$250**
- Installation requiring new holes or door modifications: **A$250–A$450+**
- If you've already purchased the lock, labour is often in the **A$150–A$250** range. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/footscray-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth confirming:
- The **brand and model** of your smart lock (e.g. Yale, Aqara, Eufy, Lockly).
- Your **door thickness** and **backset** dimensions.
- Whether the installer will also **set up the app**, fingerprints, PINs, or HomeKit/Google Home integration.

If you haven't bought a lock yet, I can also recommend the best smart lock for your door type and budget.
